title: WorkspaceChangesResult
description:
`workspace.changes` result: bounded, read-only git working-tree summary.

`warning` is present when git is unavailable / the workspace is not a repository / the output was truncated; `items` is empty in those cases where no reliable listing is available.

items.description: Changed paths, sorted by path (bounded by the host).

warning.description: Human-readable non-fatal warning (omitted when the scan was clean).

add.description: Coarse added/untracked/modified marker (`1` when this path is not a deletion).

del.description: Coarse deleted marker (`1` when git reports a deletion).

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root (forward slashes when git reports them).
